title: Evidence
description: A claim about one revision of one contribution. The class determines what the claim is worth: only deterministic evidence may satisfy a requirement.

kind.description: Requirement name this evidence answers to.

class.description: deterministic: reproducible by a third party, may bind. assessed: heuristic or model judgement, never binds. attested: a human took responsibility.

outcome.description: inconclusive is treated as unmet, never as a pass.

subject_digest.description: Revision the claim is about. Must equal the contribution head_digest to bind.

summary.description: Free-form detail. Never parsed for control flow.

signer.description: Cryptographically verified identity of the signer. OUTPUT ONLY: a conformant implementation MUST ignore this field on input. A signer is a conclusion a verifier reaches, never a claim a document makes.
